name: Dosukoi! Onna Yuki-zumou ~Mune ga Dokidoki Hatsubasho Taiken~
original_name: どすこい！女雪相撲～胸がドキドキ初場所体験～
source:
Tanpopo is a female Sumo wrestler. She enters university and joins the female Sumo club, which is famous for a strong Sumo wrestler, Sayuri. But Sayuri says, "If you're not a virgin, you won't be able to join the club!!"

Though Tanpopo has a boyfriend, Hiro, she is still a virgin. She is somehow allowed to join the club, but she is totally confused with the customs of the club. Also, Hiro persistently tries to have sex with her.

Will she be able to protect her virginity? Will she be able to become a strong Sumo wrestler? 

[From ErogeShop]
translation:
蒲公英是一名女子相扑选手。进入大学后，她加入了女子相扑社。社团因实力强劲的相扑选手小百合而闻名，可小百合却说：“不是处女的话，就不能加入社团！！”

虽然蒲公英有个名叫广的男朋友，但她仍是处女。她不知为何获准入社，却被社团里的种种规矩弄得不知所措。与此同时，广还一再想和她发生关系。

她能守住处女之身吗？又能成为强大的相扑选手吗？

[摘自ErogeShop]
